items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Howard Johnson. [INTERVIEWEE] No I don’t think so. I think it was Ronnie Cuber actually.

ctx.x: Ray Phiri, maybe. Or there’s another guy’s name starts with a V. And it was just a rhythm guitar part. They said, “Can you make a brass section play that and by the way we really want to have a bass saxophone on the bottom, a B flat bass saxophone. I said sure.
No I don’t think so. I think it was Ronnie Cuber actually.
